description.fun: Torchic carries a fire inside its belly that burns as long as it lives, so hugging one feels like holding a hot-water bottle. It spits fireballs at 1,000°C that leave foes scorched black, but it dislikes the dark and toddles after its Trainer on unsteady legs. Its bright orange colour is modelled on painted chicks sold at festivals, and males have a tiny black speck on their rear.
description.guide: A small Fire-type chick Pokémon and one of Hoenn's three first partners, with a flame sac in its belly that keeps it warm to the touch. It can shoot fireballs at foes. It evolves into Combusken and then Blaziken.
description.tagline: A warm, fluffy chick with a fire that never goes out

description.fun: Combusken trains its legs by running through its habitat until they're equally fast and powerful, able to unleash ten kicks a second. It screeches loudly in battle to distract and intimidate its opponent, but sleeps much more quietly, the best time to study one up close. It began the run of Fire- and Fighting-type first partner evolutions that carried on through Generations 4 and 5.
description.guide: A Fire- and Fighting-type chicken Pokémon, the middle stage of the Torchic line, with powerful legs for rapid kicks. Its internal flame burns stronger as it fights. It evolves into Blaziken at level 36.
description.tagline: A noisy kickboxing chick that throws ten kicks a second

description.fun: Blaziken's legs can clear a 30-storey building in a single bound, and it wreathes its fists and feet in fire from its wrists and ankles to fight like a martial artist, with flames burning hotter against stronger foes. Every few years its old feathers burn away and new ones grow in, like a phoenix's. It's so keen on battle that it kicks and blows flames in its sleep.
description.guide: A Fire- and Fighting-type Pokémon, the final form of Torchic: a tall, bird-like fighter that can wreathe its fists and feet in flames. Its strong legs give it powerful kicks and huge jumps. It can Mega Evolve into Mega Blaziken.
description.tagline: A fire-fisted fighting bird that can leap a skyscraper

description.fun: Mega Blaziken hones the kicks it takes such pride in, unleashing flurries so savage that its legs can start to burn from friction with the air. Boiling blood courses through it, and the hotter it gets, the faster and stronger it becomes.
